description: This Java class 'Cache' manages entity caching, including storing, retrieving, and removing cached entity data, with support for different cache types and cache invalidation based on entity properties.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A class providing caching mechanisms for entity data, supporting operations like get, put, remove, and clear for different cache types.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries by entity name or specific entity.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached data: a single value, list, or object based on parameters.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores data into cache: single value, list, or entity.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes specific cache entries based on entity, condition, or primary key.
